description: Introduction — welcome, battlefield grid, and the three Progeny.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Welcome Commander, to Tactica: a Space Opera.<page/>Your goal is to conquer this frontier space sector for control of its BISMUTH.<page/>Your task is to build an army, defend your structures, and crush any opposition.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: The battlefield is made of a grid of squares. Cleverly mastering positioning, attack ranges, terrain, and units all matter.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Three PROGENY fight for control of the BISMUTH:The Ertrians Bismuth is the most valuable metal in the galaxy. The Virix Heat provided by Bismuth supports their reproduction and allows for growth on hostile planets. The Sentus A religious monarchy. Proximity to Bismuth provides them their strength.Each faction has its own production rules and bonuses.You will learn universal tactics first, then faction specifics.
